description: 19,936 recreation trail and feature lines managed by Recreation Sites and Trails BC. Published by Recreation Sites and Trails BC (Province of British Columbia) as [Recreation Line](https://catalogue.data.gov.bc.ca/dataset/recreation-line) in the BC Data Catalogue; this is a full province-wide mirror. Query recipes and field notes are in [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md).

table:columns.name: RMF_SKEY
table:columns.description: The unique identifier (called an SKEY) for the Recreation Map Feature.

table:columns.name: FOREST_FILE_ID
table:columns.description: An identifier assigned to the recreation file, e.g., REC16098.

table:columns.name: SECTION_ID
table:columns.description: An identifier assigned to a section of a recreation trail, e.g., 1, 10, A, B, EATON LAKE.

table:columns.name: RECREATION_MAP_FEATURE_CODE
table:columns.description: Code that identifies the type of recreation feature, i.e., IF (interpretive forest trail), RTR (recreation trail).

table:columns.name: PROJECT_TYPE
table:columns.description: Description of the type of recreation feature, i.e., Interpretative Forest, Recreation Trail.

table:columns.name: RETIREMENT_DATE
table:columns.description: For a retired recreation feature, this is the date and time the recreation feature was retired.

table:columns.name: AMENDMENT_ID
table:columns.description: The number of times a feature has been amended over its lifetime.

table:columns.name: MAP_LABEL
table:columns.description: The default label often used when displaying the feature on a map, and consists of the FOREST FILE ID and SECTION ID separated by a space, e.g., REC4531 15, REC3069 EATON LAKE.

table:columns.name: PROJECT_NAME
table:columns.description: The name of the area or trail network, usually a geographic name, e.g., OKEOVER TRAILS.

table:columns.name: RECREATION_FEATURE_CODE
table:columns.description: Code describing the type of natural or man made recreation feature, e.g., H3 (Historic Route).

table:columns.name: RESOURCE_FEATURE_IND
table:columns.description: Indicates whether this is a resource feature established under the Government Action Regulation.

table:columns.name: RIGHT_OF_WAY
table:columns.description: The entire width of the Right of Way for the linear feature.

table:columns.name: ARCH_IMPACT_ASSESS_IND
table:columns.description: Indicates if an archaeological impact assessment has been performed for the given project.

table:columns.name: SITE_LOCATION
table:columns.description: The closest town or city to the recreation feature, e.g. KELOWNA, BELLA COOLA.

table:columns.name: PROJECT_ESTABLISHED_DATE
table:columns.description: This is the date on which the recreation project was legally established.

table:columns.name: RECREATION_DISTRICT_CODE
table:columns.description: A comma-separated list of codes relating to the recreation districts that the recreation feature is within, e.g., RDCO,RDKB,RDOS.

table:columns.name: DEFINED_CAMPSITES
table:columns.description: The total number of campsites.

table:columns.name: LIFE_CYCLE_STATUS_CODE
table:columns.description: The life cycle state of the feature, e.g., PENDING, ACTIVE, RETIRED.

table:columns.name: FILE_STATUS_CODE
table:columns.description: The current status of the recreation tenure, eg. AR (archived), HI (issued), PI (pending issuance).

table:columns.name: DISTRICT_CODE
table:columns.description: The code of the natural resource district associated with this feature.

table:columns.name: DISTRICT_NAME
table:columns.description: The name of the natural resource district associated with this feature.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_CLASS_SKEY
table:columns.description: Unique identifier for the spatial feature class.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_LENGTH
table:columns.description: Spatial perimeter length in metres. This value is calculated in the source system.

table:columns.name: FEATURE_LENGTH_M
table:columns.description: The system calculated length or perimeter of a geometry in meters.

table:columns.name: OBJECTID
table:columns.description: A column required by spatial layers that interact with ESRI ArcSDE. It is populated with unique values automatically by SDE.

table:columns.name: SE_ANNO_CAD_DATA
table:columns.description: A binary column used by spatial tools to store annotation, curve features and CAD data when using the SDO_GEOMETRY storage data type.

table:columns.name: geometry_bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: float not null, ymin: float not null, xmax: float not null, ymax: float not null>

title: Recreation Line
